title: Sky-high Jamsil
theme: Chuseok day — stick to places confirmed open
summary: Lotte World Tower day: lake walk, French bistro lunch at the Sofitel, glass-floor observatory, then back near home for a hotel buffet and the Banpo rainbow fountain.

stops.note: Flat loop around the lake with the tower above you.
French bistro & boulangerie in the Sofitel, 5 min from the lake. Hotel restaurant — expected open on Chuseok; book ahead.
Buy tickets online the morning of. Glass-floor Sky Deck on 118F; 120F terrace.
Mall opens noon on Chuseok day. Browse or rest before heading home.
Dinner buffet near home — no transfers needed after.
Shows at 19:30, 20:00, 20:30, 21:00, 21:30 (20 min each). Cancelled in rain or strong wind.

tips: Chuseok day: many small restaurants close — every stop here is confirmed open or a hotel/mall.
Nightcap option: MOBO Bar at JW Marriott is 15 min on foot from the fountain.
Want Korean fine dining instead? Bicena (81F, Lotte World Tower) is open 12:30 on Chuseok day.
Rather sit down? Lotte Cinema Super Plex G (one of Korea's biggest screens) is in the same mall — Hollywood films play in English with Korean subtitles (look for 자막).

title: Downtown lights
theme: Chuseok holiday — modern downtown, no palaces
summary: Zaha Hadid's DDP, a Michelin-starred Mediterranean lunch, Apple Myeongdong and the shopping lanes, sunset from N Seoul Tower, then Alabama BBQ and live jazz in Itaewon.

stops.note: Walk the silver curves and roof path for free; exhibitions inside are optional.
Michelin-starred Mediterranean at Piknic; open Sat 26 lunch (closed on the 25th). Book ahead.
Glass-and-light flagship — try the latest devices, no pressure to buy.
K-beauty flagships with instant tax refunds — bring passports.
Take bus 01A/01B or the cable car up — not the steep walk. Sunset ≈18:17; the observatory ticket is optional.
Brisket and ribs platters to share; the Mega platter + a side feeds five.
Korea's oldest jazz club, live bands nightly. Cover ₩15,000 per person per set; book a table for 5.

tips: From N Seoul Tower to Itaewon: bus down or a Venti/TADA van (~10 min).
Gigas is small — reserve today if you want lunch there; fallback lunch: Pierre Gagnaire (French, Lotte Hotel).
Show option: NANTA (wordless kitchen-percussion comedy) is 3 min from the Myeongdong stop — check weekend showtimes on nanta.co.kr.

title: Yeouido & the river
summary: Seoul's most futuristic department store, the Centre Pompidou's new Seoul branch and the reopened 63 Building sky deck, then sunset on the Han River from a tethered balloon and a boat, and a nightcap 37 floors up at the Conrad.

stops.note: Indoor garden and waterfall on 5F; eat lunch at the basement food hall.
Opened June 2026 inside the 63 Building — Paris collection loans. Book timed tickets.
Same building as the Pompidou: 60th-floor deck (reopened June 2026) with a Starbucks up top.
Rent a mat, order chicken to the park — very Seoul.
Tethered balloon 130 m up; sunset ~18:17. Weather cancels it — check before going.
Take an evening sailing, not the day tour — city lights on both banks.
37th-floor whisky lounge at the Conrad with Han River views. Smart-casual.

tips: Everything after lunch is along the river in Yeouido Hangang Park — short flat walks.

title: Gangnam future
theme: Monday — tech, design, steak and cocktails
summary: Starfield Library and the COEX WAVE screen, a Hyundai car-tech showroom, Gentle Monster's surreal Haus Dosan, then Wolfgang's steak and a world-ranked cocktail bar.

stops.note: 13 m bookshelves; photos best before 11:00.
Browse and have lunch in the mall.
Giant 3D wave screen. Bongeunsa Stn exit 7 is right beside it.
Free car-tech showroom; concept cars and design exhibits.
Robotic art installations + Nudake desserts in the basement.
Dry-aged porterhouse for 2–3 is enough for 5 with sides.
Asia's 50 Best Bars; sustainable cocktails, relaxed lounge feel.

tips: Gucci Osteria is closed Mondays — that's why Wolfgang's is tonight.
Tired feet? Megabox COEX has Seoul's only Dolby Cinema, right under the mall.

title: Seongsu & Hannam
theme: Tuesday — design district, art, last-night drinks
summary: Seoul Forest, Seongsu's art and concept-store scene, Leeum's modern architecture, the Hyundai Card music library, then Mexican in Hannam and a rooftop bar.

stops.note: Flat park paths; deer enclosure near the Seongsu side.
Photo-friendly experiential art; buy tickets online. Rooftop worth the walk up.
Gallery-like dessert shop from Gentle Monster's team.
Raw-concrete fragrance flagship — free testers.
Warehouse café-gallery for a light lunch.
Buildings by Botta, Nouvel and Koolhaas. Head for the contemporary-art building (M2) and the lobby installations; skip the traditional wing if you've had enough history. Closes 18:00.
Library floor needs a Hyundai Card or a DIVE-app sign-up; the vinyl shop and café are open to all.
Open from 17:15 on Tuesdays; tacos and mezcal.
Indoor-outdoor rooftop at the Mondrian; weekdays are calmer than weekends. Reserve a terrace table on CatchTable.

tips: Seongsu → Hannam is quickest by taxi (~15 min).
Last night: Privilege is a 25 min taxi from home.
Prefer Italian? Borgo (Hannam, TA 4.8) — small room, book days ahead.
Rainy? CGV Cine de Chef (Apgujeong) serves a chef's course at recliner seats before the film.
